meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 把 Linear 接入 Claude：它会参与 issue 的评论线程，团队 issue 下的每条评论都会自动触发它回复，无需 @ 提及。每个 issue 的评论线程是各自独立的会话。
howto.when: 当你为某个 Linear 团队配置好 webhook、凭据并接上 agent 后，该团队 issue 下的任何新评论都会触发它，无需 @ 提及。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 团队 ENG 接入，用 OAuth 应用身份发评论。
say.note: 会走一遍安装步骤并写入凭据。

say.text: Linear 评论一直没触发回复，帮我查 webhook 设置。
say.note: 会核对 URL、团队、Comment 事件和签名密钥。

howto.what_en: Adds Linear as a channel: Claude takes part in issue comment threads, and every comment on the team's issues triggers a reply with no @-mention. Each issue thread is its own separate session.
howto.when_en: After you set up the Linear webhook, credentials and team wiring, any new comment on an issue in that team engages it — no @-mention needed.

say_en.text: Connect my Linear team ENG, posting as an OAuth app identity.
say_en.note: Runs the install steps and writes the credentials.

say_en.text: Set Linear up with a Personal API key instead of an OAuth app.
say_en.note: Switches to key mode; your own comments get filtered.

say_en.text: Linear comments never trigger a reply — check my webhook setup.
say_en.note: Checks URL, team, Comment event and signing secret.
